steps.hardClue: Assemble five parts on the roof, then use the completed vehicle to reach another area.
steps.clue: Build the plane and fly to the Golden Gate Bridge.

steps.hardClue: Collect five fuel cans and refuel the vehicle to make the journey twice more.
steps.clue: Refuel the plane and fly to the bridge twice more.

steps.hardClue: Enter four three-digit codes on the keypad at the bottom of the spiral staircase.
steps.clue: In Afterlife, enter the four prisoner numbers on the spiral-staircase keypad.

steps.hardClue: Follow the five headphone recordings to the roof.
steps.clue: Follow the five headphone recordings to the roof.

steps.hardClue: Have every player enter their spectral form and board the vehicle from the roof.
steps.clue: Have every player enter Afterlife and board the plane from the roof.

steps.hardClue: Have one player defeat the other three on the bridge.
steps.clue: Have Weasel kill the other mobsters on the bridge to break the cycle.
